messages:
lin: Heads-up — runtime team merged the aggressive batching + new quantization-profile defaults. We need a short release note, an updated migration guide, and to sweep SDK snippets (py/js) that set batching or quant profiles. cc @rachel @samir :eyes:
rachel: Thanks. Is there a definitive list of user-facing changes we should call out? I can draft the blurb if someone gives bullets.
samir: Quick bullets from runtime: 1) default batching.policy set to "aggressive" (better throughput for long sequences) 2) new quantization profile "q8-dynmix" enabled for x86-gpu images 3) older profile names (q4_0/q4_1) still supported but deprecated.
morgan: Known caveat: small-sequence latency can increase ~10-20ms under aggressive batching in low-concurrency envs — we should call that out as a known issue and show how to opt out.
lin: Good. For snippets: update Python SDK example that previously used `client.generate(..., batching=None)` — show new opt-out flag `batching.policy = "none"` and how to pin quant profile in the call.
rachel: Draft snippets:```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.generate(model="redwood-1-small", prompt=prompt, config={"batching": {"policy": "none"}, "quant_profile": "q4_1"})
```
rachel: JS snippet too? I can add that after review.
samir: Please also add migration section: how to opt out globally (console + config), and a command-line example for private deployment. Also link to the kernel-selection note (internal link: /docs/runtime/kernel-selection) — check link health.
morgan: For the release note headline: "Serving: default batching and quantization profile updates" — short 2-line blurb + 1 bullet for known issue and 1 call-to-action to update SDK snippets.
lin: OK I'll assemble a short relnote draft in the repo PR and ping reviewers. Who can do the link sweep? docops-bot: scheduled link-check job queued for docs repo: run id 4832. Expect results in ~10m.
lin: @docops-bot perfect, please unskip the migration guide PR if the link checks pass.
docops-bot: link-check completed for run id 4832 — 2 broken anchors found (kernel-selection.md#old-kernels -> should be kernel-selection.md#kernel-selection). Posted results to #ci-notices and created issue #726 in docs tracker.
rachel: I'll update the PR with the new snippets and the known issue callout. Can someone sanity-check the wording? Draft: "We updated default batching to 'aggressive' to improve throughput for typical long-sequence workloads. If you rely on sub-100-token latency, you may see slightly higher tail latency; to restore prior behavior set `batching.policy: 'none'` in your client config or pin a per-route batching override in the Console."
samir: Wording looks good. Add short example for private deploy CLI:```bash
redwoodctl set global-config --batching.policy=none --quant_profile=q4_1
```
morgan: Also add a QA note: run your perf suite with sequence lengths matching production before switching. Tagging ops owners for Dedicated customers so they can prepare rollouts.
lin: Great. Final todo list: Rachel -> update PR with py/js snippets + known-issue blurb; Samir -> add migration CLI and private deploy instructions; Morgan -> add ops rollout notes + mention in Dedicated handbook; DocOps -> resolve link issue #726 and re-run check. I'll merge the relnote once snippets land and CI is green. :thumbsup:
